headline: Danny Simmons, Painter and Activist From a Creative Family, Dies at 72
context: The older brother of the music mogul Russell Simmons and the rapper Joseph Simmons, he made his own way as an artistic and entrepreneurial force in Brooklyn.

sources.name: The New York Times
